sentences.text: Slackia equolifaciens, an equol-producing bacterium isolated from human faeces, was described as Gram-positive, obligately anaerobic, non-spore-forming, asaccharolytic and rod-shaped.
Eggerthella and Slackia species are described as gut-associated bacteria suggested to play roles in host lipid and xenobiotic metabolism.
Using quantitative PCR in the faeces of 19 human volunteers, a study measured Slackia species at a mean count of 3.1 times ten to the fifth colony-forming units per gram.
A study in gnotobiotic rats reported that Slackia isoflavoniconvertens, isolated from humans, converts the dietary isoflavones daidzein and genistein to equol and 5-hydroxy-equol.
